info.title: FactoryPulse AI API
info.description:
Manufacturing analytics API: data import, KPI engine, quality & downtime analysis, statistical anomaly detection and report generation. All KPI ratios are returned as decimal fractions (0.85 = 85 %); `null` means *not computable from the available data* (shown as N/A).

**Authentication:** session cookie from `POST /api/auth/login`; state-changing requests must send the `X-CSRF-Token` header returned by `/api/auth/me`. Roles: viewer < analyst < admin.
